item.title: 5.2.4-beta.1
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.2.4 Beta 1 - Edge Peek, Smarter Menus & Easy App Stacks! 🫣📌✨

🆕 New

  • Show at screen edge while hidden: A new per-dock option in Manager → your dock → Behavior. When Hide on Fullscreen or Hide on Window Hover has hidden a dock pinned to a screen edge, rest the pointer on that edge to bring it back. It hides again when you move away. Thanks to Radek for the idea!
  • App Stacks from the right-click menu: Right-click an app, folder or file and choose "New App Stack with" or "Add to App Stack"!
  • Timer presets: Pick 5, 10, 15, 25 or 60 minutes, or choose Custom and type the minutes. Saved timers keep their exact time!

🚀 Improved

  • Menus beside the item: Right-click and Control-click menus open centred beside the item, like the macOS Dock, and never cover the dock!
  • Clearer Reserve Dock Space: The dock editor tells you when Reserve Dock Space is off in Settings and lets you turn it on right there!
  • Smoother first hover: The first item name after launch no longer stutters!
  • Manage Devices: License keys get a Manage Devices… button that opens your licenses page in Appit Services!
  • AI assistant changes are kept: Saving an open settings sheet no longer undoes a change an AI assistant or a dock menu made meanwhile!
  • No error-reporting library: ExtraDock no longer includes one (it never sent anything), and the Privacy section in Settings → General is gone!
  • Better Export Logs: Exported logs now include widget log lines too!

🐛 Fixed

  • The Shelf stays a shelf: After you add files it shows a full tray with a count badge instead of file icons!
  • Focus filters remember your docks: Docks to Show and Docks to Hide now keep your choice on macOS 26.5. Filters made with an older version need their docks picked again once.

✅ What to test

  • Turn on "Show at screen edge while hidden" on a pinned dock, then open a fullscreen app or maximize a window over the dock and rest the pointer on the edge.
  • Right-click items on bottom, side and top docks: the menu opens beside the item.
  • Make a new App Stack and add an app to it from the right-click menu.
  • Set a Timer with a preset and with Custom minutes.
  • With an AI assistant connected, change a widget while its settings sheet is open, then Save: both changes stay.
  • Drop files on a Shelf, and re-pick docks in a Focus filter.

This is a beta build. Thank you for testing! Please send anything that looks off, with Export Logs, to support@appitstudio.com.

ExtraDock 5.2.3 - Steadier, Quieter & Smarter Folders! 🛠️📂✨

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Folder popup keyboard: Press Space to preview the selected file in Quick Look and Space again to close it, and use the arrow keys and Escape, even while another app is in front. Before, the keys went to that app instead!
  • Settings and Manager open safely: Fixed a crash when opening Settings or the Manager while window previews are on!
  • No more Keychain prompt at launch: ExtraDock no longer asks for your Keychain password every time it starts!
  • More stable: Fixed crashes that could happen on launch, in folder widgets, in other widgets and in fullscreen detection!
  • Auto-hide handle: A collapsed floating dock with auto-hide stays hidden until you reach its handle, and on macOS 27 its handle now fades out completely instead of staying on screen!
  • Collapsed docks stay collapsed: A bar dock you left collapsed starts collapsed again after a relaunch!
  • Quit means quit: The AI assistant helper no longer launches ExtraDock every time a Claude session starts!
  • Reserve Dock Space: It no longer gets stuck!
  • Choosers open smoothly: Picking folders, apps, icons and files opens above the dock without freezing it!

🚀 Improvements

  • Window Previews switch: Turn window previews on or off straight from the menu-bar menu!
  • Export Logs in the menu bar: "Export Logs…" is now in the menu-bar menu, so sending diagnostics to Appit Studio support is one click away!
  • Folder popup previews: The folder popup shows file previews, press Space for Quick Look, and can optionally close after you drag a file out. It also opens faster!
  • Open folders with any app: "Open folders with" can pick any app again, including Bloom!
  • AI Assistants: Add ExtraDock to Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and ChatGPT (Codex) right from Settings!
  • Collapse state remembered: Your docks remember whether they were collapsed!
  • Smoother window previews: Previews draw in step with your display for a steadier look!
  • Faster popovers: Folder Stack, Now Playing and folder View Options open faster!
  • Lighter: Lower memory use over long sessions!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
